videos.title: The Score
videos.description: Crypto flooded football. Then the market turned. CNBC's Tom Chitty follows the sponsorship boom, the fallout for clubs and fans, and the search for what survives after the hype. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Answers with Bayless Conley
videos.description: Answers about life with Pastor Bayless Conley of Cottonwood Church in California, Bayless is known for his clear and practical sermons. As a teenager he got into drugs and alcohol for many years whilst searching for the truth, at once he began to read the Bible which helped him find the answers to the questions he was looking for. Therefore not only his past turned around but the sympathetic nature allowed him to appeal to many different people as well. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Leaders Playbook
videos.description: Go inside Netflix, the #1 streaming platform in the world. Julia Boorstin explores CEO Ted Sarandos' leadership playbook to understand the strategies that changed what we watch and how we watch it, covering his journey from video store manager to global hit maker and how he empowers his teams to succeed. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Managing Asia
videos.description: Christine Tan sits down with Young Liu, chairman of Hon Hai Technology Group, better known globally as Foxconn, to discuss its bets on AI, EVs, satellites and quantum computing. As revenue nearly doubles under his leadership, Liu reflects on a missed EV target and the challenge of succeeding founder Terry Gou. (Senderinfo).

videos.description: A wannabe art dealer sells fake works by American masters of Abstract Expressionism in an $80 million scam, fooling rich collectors and pocketing millions. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Golf: US PGA Tour – The RSM Classic
Reaction Sports
videos.description: We begin in Shanghai, China, for the F1H20 World Championship, then head to Nuremberg, Germany, for the Night of the Jumps FMX Finals. Next, we travel to Japan for the PWA Fly ANA Yokosuka Miru Wind Surf World Cup, then return to China, this time to Beijing, for the Velo Solutions UCI Pump Track World Championship. Finally, we're in Olbia, Italy, for the UIM Aquabike Regione Sardegna GP of Italy. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: The Tech Download
videos.description: Payward co-CEO Dave Ripley joins Arjun Kharpal to discuss tokenized equities, stablecoins and why he believes traditional stock exchanges will eventually move to 24/7 trading. They also explore AI agents, crypto security and the outlook for digital assets. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Leaders Playbook
videos.description: Go inside Netflix, the #1 streaming platform in the world. Julia Boorstin explores CEO Ted Sarandos' leadership playbook to understand the strategies that changed what we watch and how we watch it, covering his journey from video store manager to global hit maker and how he empowers his teams to succeed. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: American Greed
videos.description: Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick runs a criminal empire out of City Hall.. Once hailed as the savior of this struggling rust-belt metropolis, Kilpatrick is actually the leader of a cabal that cost the city millions of dollars. Throughout his six year tenure, Kilpatrick and his friends extort city contractors, abuse public funds, and turn the mayor's office into their own cash-making machine. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Managing Middle East
videos.description: Conflict is changing the way goods move through the Gulf. Aramex CEO Amadou Diallo joins Dan Murphy to discuss new growth opportunities, shifting trade flows and the growing role of AI in powering the logistics giant's next chapter. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Built For Billions
videos.description: From dominating the mobile phone era with devices like the 3310 to reinventing itself around telecom infrastructure, Nokia's story is one of tech's biggest transformations. Now, the company is betting on AI-driven networks and 6G to shape the future of global connectivity. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Executive Decisions
videos.description: IFS CEO Mark Moffat explains why he left a successful 24-year career at PwC to pursue a new challenge, and how a conversation years earlier helped shape his ambition to reach his full potential. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Leaders Playbook
videos.description: Julia Boorstin interviews Danny Meyer, the founder of Shake Shack – one of the fastest growing restaurant chains in America, exploring his leadership playbook to reveal the strategies that helped the serial entrepreneur turn a hot dog cart in NYC into an international burger empire. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: In Touch Ministries
videos.description: In Touch Ministries is a long-running television series in which senior pastor of the First Baptist Church in Atlanta, Dr Charles Stanley, shares lessons about the Christian faith. He discusses various themes, such as family, prayer, motherhood and fear, addressing stories from the Bible and offering a deeper understanding of Christian teachings. Join him as he explains what faith means in modern day life, and why it is necessary for finding inner peace. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Joseph Prince
videos.description: Religious programme hosted by Joseph Prince. Prince is the senior pastor and co-founder of the New Creation Church in Singapore – a large non-denominational Christian church in Asia. This programme features Prince's spiritual messages on life and faith, sermons, his religious interpretations and words of praise and worship. With his energetic and sometimes humorous style, Joseph Prince has spoken to audiences across the world. His words are broadcast globally across North America, Europe, Africa, and Australia. He is also the author of numerous religious and spiritual books. (Senderinfo).

Big investors, smart strategists and top money managers debate actionable ideas and the big market themes of the day, and get viewers ready for tomorrow's trading day. (Senderinfo).
